experiment: GlassRadio V44 continuation: strong-baseline, canonical eviction policy, adaptive cascade retrieval, admission opportunity-cost, lifecycle scaling, and offline-DP oracle audit
wire_protocol: identical to V41/V43 RAW/COPY/BIT/BYTE/RUN; receiver byte-for-byte reused; no new codec
information_constraint: all retrieval uses only (observed, visible_mask, current cache); full target used only after retrieval for reversible encoding and admission; identical observation streams per session across methods

amendments_before_first_valid_run: K=65536 -> 65535: the frozen V41 wire format uses 16-bit reference/write IDs with 0xFFFF reserved as the no-write sentinel, so the maximum addressable cache is 65,535 slots.
Added a third strong-baseline full-scan kernel FULL2 (branchless single-pass top-2) so that the index-vs-scan comparison is not contingent on one micro-kernel.

A prior run with a corrupted packet-audit target field (local variable dec shadowed std::dec) was discarded; its byte results were identical and are re-validated by the discrete-determinism replay check.
arm_main.prewarm: 2*K RAW/COPY alternating, identical to V43 (16*K warm bytes, charged to lifecycle)

arm_long.note: tests the lifecycle amortization identity S(T)=dB*T/(W+b0*T) derived in the report

arm_evict.note: eviction pressure arm: makes the LRU/SIEVE/GDS comparison meaningful (V43 write pressure ~48/16384 was ~0)

arm_oracle.note: offline exact DP with the same cost function; bounds the joint retrieval+admission decision headroom

retrieval_methods.FULLS: scalar full masked-Hamming scan (V43 replica, vector-insert top-2)
retrieval_methods.FULLT: tuned two-pass histogram full masked-Hamming scan (strong baseline; same information, same answer, better constant)
retrieval_methods.CAS64_FULLT: cascade: recent-64 first, escalate to FULLT iff stage-1 packet > 10 B (max non-RAW envelope)

eviction_policies.SIEVE: canonical circular SIEVE (hand + visited bit set on hit, cleared as hand passes, insert at evicted slot)
eviction_policies.GDS: Greedy-Dual-Size, H = L + size/cost, size = last wire bytes of the object

admission_policies.ALWAYS: V43 default: write on even updates when not exact-duplicate, <=6 per 12
admission_policies.ONRAW: value-aware: write only when the encoder chose RAW (no near neighbour in cache)

cascade_threshold_rationale: theta = 10 bytes is the maximum size of any non-RAW packet in the frozen codec (BIT/BYTE/RUN max payload 10 B); escalating when stage-1 exceeds 10 B means 'no codec mode can save this frame', so it is codec-derived, not tuned on test data
primary: among methods with per-update sender thread-CPU P99 <= 50 us in all repeats and zero lossless/receiver violations: paired whole-session lifecycle and test bytes vs strongest feasible baseline
cpu_threshold_note: 50 us remains a laboratory diagnostic threshold measured with CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID on this build; no RF, energy, or real-device deadline claim
statistics: domain-stratified paired cluster bootstrap on whole independent synthetic sessions; 4000 resamples; seed 2026110404; no per-frame resampling
stop_rule: if a feasible strong simple baseline matches the best index/cascade method on lifecycle bytes within the same budget, the index/joint-decision claim is NO-GO on this benchmark
true_new_training: none; no learned model trained or used; learned baselines remain INCONCLUSIVE
provenance: new seeds (2026110403/04/05); frozen V43 artifacts untouched and hash-verified before and after
